## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/registermcinstrinfofn">RegisterMCInstrInfoFn</a> - Helper template for registering a target instruction info implementation.</p>


<p>This invokes the specified function to do the construction. Usage:</p>


<p>extern "C" void LLVMInitializeFooTarget() { extern <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/target">Target</a> TheFooTarget; <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/registermcinstrinfofn">RegisterMCInstrInfoFn</a> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/tablegen/tablegenbackendskeleton-cpp/#ab60f28d7a141ac46ccc200176a1bca8b">X(TheFooTarget, TheFunction)</a>; }</p>
